references.text: Samson sought an opportunity against the Philistines, who at that time ruled over Israel
Samson declares again that he will take revenge on the Philistines
Samson explains that he only does to the Philistines what they have done to him
The earlier conflict between Samson and the Philistines that led to his desire for vengeance
The principle that evil comes from the wicked, which justifies retaliation
Paul urges leaving vengeance to God, in contrast to Samson's personal revenge
